scenes.title: B1 Hook: endless tabs
scenes.description: Mock browser, tabs spawn fast: LinkedIn Jobs, Google Sheets job tracker, ChatGPT cover letter, Gmail. Cursor darts. Type: 'busy work'. [Remotion mock browser]
scenes.vo: There's a lot of busy work when it comes to getting a job.
scenes.notes: Remotion. Must work as standalone hook for cutdowns.

scenes.title: B2 Busywork montage
scenes.description: One idea per shot ~1s: Finding=job board doomscroll · Resume=resume-v7-FINAL-final.docx save dialog · Cover letter=ChatGPT regenerating · Networking=LinkedIn Connect clicks · Applying=Workday login. Word stamps each shot. [Remotion mocks]
scenes.vo: Finding the job, writing the resume, the cover letter, networking, and even applying to it.

scenes.title: B3 Hundreds of hours
scenes.description: Nick desk timelapse day-to-night, coffee cups pile up. Insert: iOS screen-time card (LinkedIn 11h · Sheets 6h · ChatGPT 9h). Big type: 'Hundreds of hours.'
scenes.vo: Hundreds of hours wasted on boring, repetitive work to get that offer.
scenes.notes: NICK FILMS timelapse. Screen-time card Remotion.

scenes.title: B4 Turn: let Scout take over
scenes.description: All tabs/sheets/docs sweep off screen leaving one clean Offerloop window on #F5F6F8. Beat of calm.
scenes.vo: Instead, let Scout take care of it.

scenes.title: B5 Logo hero
scenes.description: Wordmark assembles letter by letter, hero line: Search. Reach out. Get hired.

scenes.title: B6 Apply: ON IT
scenes.asset: assets/generated/Offerloop Pricing Student Plans for College Networking 13 July 2026.mp4
scenes.description: Tilted 3D product UI, job card swipe right, green stamp ON IT. Crop content area (avoid webcam bubble).
scenes.vo: Need to apply to something? On it.
scenes.notes: Footage: Job Board/Applications sections; fallback Remotion mock.

scenes.title: B7 Find & email people: DONE
scenes.asset: assets/generated/Offerloop Pricing Student Plans for College Networking 13 July 2026.mp4
scenes.description: 'Who do you want to meet?' search types itself (Auditor at EY in Portland), 1 person found, Draft 1 email, 'Placing drafts in your Gmail...', stamp DONE (bigger).
scenes.vo: Find and email people at a company? Done.

scenes.title: B8 Hiring manager: DONE
scenes.asset: assets/generated/Offerloop Pricing Student Plans for College Networking 13 July 2026.mp4
scenes.description: My Network 'Hiring Managers 23' tab, contact card zooms, badge glints, Gmail draft sends, stamp DONE (screen-filling).
scenes.vo: It'll even find the exact hiring manager for the position. Done.

scenes.title: B9 Founders
scenes.description: Nick to camera, lower-third 'Nick · cofounder'. On 'Now anyone can' cut to laptop close + golden-hour walk-out.
scenes.vo: As college students, we built this for ourselves, to save time on the job search. Now anyone can land their dream job in a fraction of the time.

scenes.title: B10 Get your time back
scenes.description: Screen-time card returns: 'Job hunt: 40 min this week.' Optional timelapse reversing behind.

scenes.title: B11 End card
scenes.description: Wordmark + summit scout peeking + offerloop.ai. Fade out.
